Initial process-local GET0, SET1, GET1 must be observed successfully before any fork; missing/initial1 is negative.
C/H/W independently GET and report0; no assumption that the property is inherited or not inherited substitutes for the observation.

Fresh reviewed symbolic prctl/SYS/signal/wait declarations and captured headers are required; no guessed syscall option/provider/architecture or old API shim.
C machine bounds, clock overflow/layout and bool-as-int rejection are required; unattempted facts remain null instead of fabricated successes.

Role/case/nonce/t0/ordinal/identity references are bound; unchanged forwarded facts and exact expected order are checked; partial/duplicate/out-of-order frames are negative.
Complete G->C->H->W ARM and final ALL_ARM_ACK receipt precede deliberate parent loss, with fresh live anchor checks afterward.
W/H park after ACK and writer closure. Receiver-observed EOF while child is live is distinguished from unavailable sender post-close return facts; EOF does not trigger early exit.
C retains only the needed G command/report edge plus C_H after forwarding H/W ACK/EOF facts, supporting either EXIT23 or FINISH.
C alone reaps original H/raw9; G checks that fact and observes live W adoption H->G while C remains alive before W signal/reap. G does not claim H wait.
C closes C_H, sends FINISH_ACK and exits0 after W cleanup; G reaps original C and completes closure/reset terminal predicate.
Separate EXIT23 command, observed C_H close/EBADF and EXIT_ACK precede C exit23; G reaps original direct C before adopted guard handling.
Before signaling H, G independently observes H.PPID=C->G with invariant identity while W is still parented by live H; C death alone cannot imply W adoption.
After G signals/reaps adopted H, G observes live W.PPID=H->G with original identity before its distinct W signal/reap.
Both successful cases have exactly one G_H and one G_W SIGKILL attempt; wait ownership differs explicitly between cases and signal rc0 alone is insufficient.
Shared monotonic t0 and absolute5/8/10/12/14 offsets order work, cleanup, terminal, guardian total and child self-expiry. No epoch reset or relative-time extension is allowed.
Malformed packet, drift, error, deadline, unobserved adoption, wrong wait, closure/reset failure and loss remain failed/unknown; no conversion to narrow success.

The separate planned/negative ledgers and target/action wording do not explicitly cap their combined signal attempts per original handle. A referenced fresh-member negative policy is not enumerated; the minimum closed negative policy must be made explicit before implementation.
G cannot signal/wait W without live adopted identity, unknown members are retained, and unobserved child self-expiry is not complete cleanup proof. These restrictions do not resolve D27.
Broad production/model/resource/foreign queue, arbitrary descendants/exec, guardian/observer/host loss and remote raw/fsync claims remain false or unproved.
Design acceptance only permits minimum source; new closure, meaningful fixtures, commit/push/reviews/PR/exact latest CI/main precede separate fresh host declaration and exact prelaunch.
Portable invalid-adoption/wait/close/default facts and strict actual Linux H-loss/C-loss with live pre-signal adoption are meaningful future fixtures, explicitly unexecuted here.

Prior outputs remain consumed; science/native/plan/freeze/data/settings, read-only PR27 venv, six future MS hosts, GPU/restore, social pending and local personal-data boundaries remain preserved as declarations without rereading/re-auditing old evidence.

findings.problem: The phrase each eligible target/action at most one and separate planned/negative cleanup ledgers could admit a second signal through the same original handle under a new ledger/action label; fresh member policy is referenced but not a closed policy. The design must cap combined attempts per original handle, not only each labeled action.
findings.required_change: Declare a closed negative policy. The minimum sufficient amendment is negative_cleanup_signals=[] and directed signals on every negative path=0; stop subsequent planned signals once failure/unknown is entered. Every attempted planned signal, including EINTR/ESRCH/ambiguous return, permanently consumes that original handle; the combined planned+negative attempt count for any original handle stays<=1. Negative paths may only bounded read/poll and correctly-owned wait with valid same identity/adoption, and once-only explicit owned descriptor close. Retain known/unknown membership and no reset/cleanup claim while required reaps are unobserved. No new PID fallback/reopen/retry or guarantee from+14 self-expiry.
findings.permitted_scope_after_fix: This amendment can support the minimum fixed two-case CPU design; it supplies no general cleanup, production, guardian/observer/host-loss or model/resource promise.

acceptance.next_action: Retain r1 candidate and finding; author an exclusive corrected new design revision, then independently review only the amendment and bind accepted unchanged checks without rerunning old completed evidence.

implementation_notes_not_new_findings: Actual source must use captured sys/wait macros and compiled SIGKILL/header facts to decode and bind recorded raw9/5888, rather than treating design literal expectations as portable ABI discovery.

Final C ARM ACK cannot prove its sole report writer is closed while it remains needed for EXIT_ACK/FINISH_ACK. Only W/H report EOF is promised before loss; C retains the G edge as explicitly designed.
